header.running_head: Rasulullaah ﷺ is Particular about Dispatching the Army of Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA) even on his Deathbed, after which Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) also Gives the Same Importance to the Matter When he Becomes the Khalifah

blocks.text:
(RA). As they came, Rasulullaah ﷺ kept saying, "Dispatch the army of Usaama." (Hadhrat Usaama (RA)'s mother) Hadhrat Ummu Ayman (RA) came to Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Do leave Usaama to stay at the camp (in Jurf) until you are well. If you send him like this, he will not be able to even help himself (because of his concern for you)." However, Rasulullaah ﷺ repeated, "Dispatch the army of Usaama." The Muslims therefore returned to the camp and spent Saturday night there. On Sunday morning, Hadhrat Usaama (RA) came to Madinah (to see Rasulullaah ﷺ). Rasulullaah ﷺ was extremely ill and unconscious. This was the day in which Rasulullaah ﷺ was given medicine.
With tears in his eyes, Hadhrat Usaama (RA) entered the room of Rasulullaah ﷺ where Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) and the wives of Rasulullaah ﷺ sat around him. Hadhrat Usaama (RA) bent down to kiss Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ was unable to speak and lifted his hands towards the sky and then placed them on Hadhrat Usaama (RA). Hadhrat Usaama (RA) says that he knew that Rasulullaah ﷺ was making du'aa for him. Hadhrat Usaama (RA) then returned to the camp. On Monday, Rasulullaah ﷺ was well and Hadhrat Usaama (RA) came to meet him early in the morning. Rasulullaah ﷺ said to him, "Travel with the blessing of Allaah." When Hadhrat Usaama (RA) bade farewell to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he was looking well. Rasulullaah ﷺ's wives were even combing each others' hair out of happiness at the recovery of Rasulullaah ﷺ. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) came to Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! With the grace of Allaah, you look well this morning. Today is my day with (my wife) Bint Khaarijah. Permit me to go to her." When Rasulullaah ﷺ permitted him, he left for the Sunh district (in the upper part of Madinah).
In the meanwhile, Hadhrat Usaama (RA) went to the army's camp and called for the others to join up with the army. When he reached the camp, he descended and commanded the men to leave. By then, the sun was already high.
Rasulullaah ﷺ Passes Away and the Sahabah (RA) Return to Madinah

As Hadhrat Usaama (RA) was preparing to leave from Jurf, a messenger came to him from Hadhrat Ummu Ayman (RA) who was his mother. The messenger informed him that Rasulullaah ﷺ was in the throes of death. Hadhrat Usaama (RA) therefore returned to Madinah together with Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA). When they arrived, Rasulullaah ﷺ was in the last few moments. Rasulullaah ﷺ then passed away close to midday on Monday 12th Rabee'ul Awwal. All the Muslims camping at Jurf returned to Madinah. Hadhrat Buraydah bin Husayb (RA) came with the flag of Hadhrat Usaama (RA) still flying and stuck it in the ground at the door of Rasulullaah ﷺ's room. After Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) became the Khalifah, he instructed Hadhrat Buraydah (RA) to take the flag to the house of Hadhrat
